item.title: Friday 4 PM Update, Oct 16
item.description:
The four o'clock update of Gumshoe News Radio for Friday, October 16, 2026, focused on what's new since three: new details on the Bend, Oregon, school shooting and the father who stopped it, the press secretary job still open, a report that the Pentagon will hold its Minab school-strike findings until after the midterms, Iran's president saying he's ready to talk, Senator Jeanne Shaheen leading a bipartisan call to investigate Ukraine's Starlink slowdown, the closing bell on the Nasdaq's worst week since June, Microsoft's next A.I. chip, Bill Gates gearing up for an A.I. safety fight, a stealthy Fortinet firewall implant, your X feed, what New Hampshire voters need to bring on November third, weekend events, and a toddler's second chance at life. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Friday 3 PM Update, Oct 16
item.description:
The three o'clock update of Gumshoe News Radio for Friday, October 16, 2026, focused on what's new since two: where Katie Zacharia lands after leaving the press secretary job, back-to-back Senate debates in Minnesota and Alaska, Iran's widening attacks on shipping around Hormuz, Alberta's referendum on Monday, Brent crude touching a hundred ten dollars and a Nasdaq headed for its worst week since June, Nvidia's open-source robot-learning kit, a fifteen-million-dollar effort to help mathematicians sort out A.I.-generated proofs, a Booz Allen test where A.I. took over a robotic arm in sixteen minutes, your X feed, Don Bolduc crossing party lines in New Hampshire's Senate race, the Loon Mountain comment deadline, and a little boy's lost ball of strings. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
